name: atelier-verite-workspace
description: Atelier Vérité — Haute Couture & Contemporary Ready-to-Wear Monorepo Workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI-SERVICE --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:ai
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai
scripts.lint: npm run check:ports && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
